Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    paths-ignore:
      - "**/*.md"
      - "LICENSE"
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths-ignore:
      - "**/*.md"
      - "LICENSE"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  quality:
    name: quality
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Test
        run: npm test
      - name: Rehearse existing-database cutover on PostgreSQL 15
        run: node --test scripts/database/cutover-postgres.integration.test.mjs
        env:
          CUTOVER_TEST_POSTGRES_IMAGE: postgres:15
      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck
      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint
      - name: Verify architecture
        run: npm run verify:architecture
      - name: Verify release gate behavior
        run: npm run verify:release
      - name: Check Drizzle schema
        run: npx --no-install drizzle-kit check --config=drizzle.config.ts
        env:
          MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL: postgresql://ci:ci@127.0.0.1:5432/ci
      - name: Build without privileged services
        run: npm run build
        env:
          APP_URL: http://localhost:3000
          BETTER_AUTH_SECRET: ci-only-placeholder-not-a-real-secret
          BETTER_AUTH_URL: http://localhost:3000
          DATABASE_URL: postgresql://ci:ci@127.0.0.1:5432/ci
          GOOGLE_AUTH_ENABLED: "false"
          NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: http://localhost:3000
          NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_AUTH_ENABLED: "false"
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: ci-only-placeholder
          NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: http://127.0.0.1:54321
          NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: "1"
          STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: ci-only-placeholder
          SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: ci-only-placeholder
      # Dev-only tooling fails on high and critical; production stays at low below.
      - name: Audit all dependencies
        run: npm audit --audit-level=high
      - name: Audit production dependencies
        run: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=low
      - name: Validate dependency tree
        run: npm ls --all
      - name: Check pull request diff
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        run: git diff --check "origin/${BASE_REF}...HEAD"
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ github.base_ref }}
      - name: Check pushed commit diff
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        run: |
          if [ "$BEFORE_SHA" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
            EMPTY_TREE=$(git hash-object -t tree /dev/null)
            git diff --check "$EMPTY_TREE...$GITHUB_SHA"
          else
            git diff --check "$BEFORE_SHA...$GITHUB_SHA"
          fi
        env:
          BEFORE_SHA: ${{ github.event.before }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
